description: Synthetic fixed observations for search-noshrink.jpp (construction check only; not model evaluation). Round 0 yields one fitting name, one rejected and one in band (refined into round 1's context); round 1 re-proposes the round-0 good name (reused, not judged again) and two new names that are both rejected, so the accumulated good names do not grow and the search ends at noshrink. The calibration record is hand-written to exercise routing.
